title: Worldline 2: Nova's navigable occurrence past

world_change: Nova surveys a persistent scrollable index of recognizable things that happened across ordinary conversation and work, then follows selected links to substance retained by its owner.
scope: New temporal query and static HTML
Existing Faculty cognition and both editions
non_scope: Retired standalone MIND and parked Arms Reach
